items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I said Aaron, Aaron Copland. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yes, right. That‟s what they said and it was … but he, he wanted to, so…. But his November Steps is the classic one and he liked to use the biwa

ctx.x: …in the late fifties—and they thought he was going to choose Copland, or, you know, some other more classical composer, and he said no, Duke Ellington, and they just … and I think they withdrew it.
No, I don‟t think John Coltrane was there at that time, yet, that time, I don‟t think he was. I don‟t think so.
